scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run secrets && npm run audit
scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run sast && npm run e2e
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:ts && npm run format:check:rs
scripts.lint: npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:rs
scripts.lint:rs: node scripts/cargo.mjs clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings -D unsafe_code -D clippy::undocumented_unsafe_blocks
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:ts && npm run typecheck:rs
scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:rs
scripts.audit: npm run audit:ts && npm run audit:rs
